label: sr_query_reward
title: Auxiliary feedback in the selected product-search programs

cells: Selected-minus-feasible mean of C3, the frequency–remaining-time–budget feature; multiply by 0.1 and bound.
Adds feedback on a particular composite operating signal, rather than on the realized transaction. Its denominator makes the signal larger at lower budget ratios.
Selected-minus-feasible mean of the bounded historical click-to-display ratio.
Compares historical click efficiency directly. The supplied S output is not used by this reward function.
Product of the selected-minus-feasible differences in (i) the product of relative CTR and relative CVR features and (ii) budget ratio times remaining time.
Rewards alignment in the signs of two relative differences. Both differences being negative also gives a positive product.
Selected-minus-feasible difference in the log click/display signal, multiplied by the budget-ratio difference and remaining progress.
Combines relative response efficiency, relative exposure availability, and time; the signal vanishes when remaining progress is zero.
Selected-minus-feasible mean of C2, followed by a bounded transformation.
Uses the centered historical click-efficiency feature. The feasible mean after the nonlinear transformation is retained.
